issues.title: Research: literature review, gap analysis, problem statement
issues.description: Establish the scientific foundation, perform literature review on memory firewalls and context retention, and define research gaps and problem statements.

issues.title: REST API endpoints + background tasks
issues.description: Implement memory management endpoints (analyze, submit, search, retrieve, update, forget) and asynchronous background tasks for memory expiration and decay.

issues.title: Initial React frontend (6 pages)

issues.title: Research evaluation: 4 baselines, 36 tests

issues.title: Research paper, ADRs, README
issues.description: Draft final research paper, complete Architectural Decision Records, and structure the README overview document.

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [1.1] Project initialization
issues.user_story: As a frontend developer, I want a modern Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 project foundation so that the team can build scalable, type-safe UI components efficiently.
issues.description: Initialize clean React 19 workspace with Tailwind v4 styling, alias paths, Zustand state management, routing scaffolds, and modern build tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Vite configuration with path aliases (@/) working without issues
TypeScript compiler strict configuration with zero build errors
Tailwind CSS v4 theme variables and base reset configured
Basic directory structure established for components, pages, routes, and stores

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [1.2] Design system — reusable UI component primitives + mock data layer
issues.user_story: As a designer and developer, I want unified design tokens and mock data schemas so that all application pages share consistent visuals and realistic test data.
issues.description: Establish cohesive color schemes, dark mode surfaces, typography hierarchy, component spacing guidelines, and schema definitions for memory entities.
acceptance_criteria: Complete color palette defined with CSS variables for dark/light surfaces
Typography scale and elevation shadows established
TypeScript schemas defined for memories, metrics, and pipeline events
Mock fixtures established with representative firewall evaluation states

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.1] Button, Badge, Spinner, Skeleton
issues.user_story: As a user, I want consistent UI feedback and loading components so that interactions feel immediate, clear, and visually stable.
issues.description: Build primary, secondary, ghost, and danger Button variants, status Badges, loading Spinners, and animated Skeleton loaders.
acceptance_criteria: Button supports variants (primary, secondary, outline, danger) and loading states
Badge supports decision colors (STORE, ENCRYPT, FORGET, COMPRESS)
Spinner offers customizable sizes and accessible aria-live status
Skeleton provides shimmer effect matching card and table layouts

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.2] Card, Modal, Drawer, Dialog
issues.user_story: As a user, I want versatile container and overlay components so that content is neatly organized and modal interactions are intuitive.
issues.description: Implement styled Card containers with header/content/footer slots, accessible Modal overlay dialogs, side Drawers, and confirmation Dialogs.
acceptance_criteria: Card supports interactive hover effects, borders, and glassmorphism styling
Modal handles focus trap, ESC key closing, and backdrop blurring
Drawer supports smooth slide-in from right/left viewports
Dialog provides standard confirm/cancel action bindings

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.3] Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Toggle
issues.user_story: As a user, I want comprehensive form controls so that I can configure firewall settings and input test memories seamlessly.
issues.description: Construct accessible Input, auto-resizing Textarea, custom Select dropdown, Checkbox, and Toggle switch primitives with validation states.
acceptance_criteria: Input and Textarea handle focus states, error messages, and helper text
Select supports search filtering and keyboard navigation
Checkbox and Toggle support indeterminate and disabled states
All controls expose proper ARIA form roles and labels

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.4] Table, Tabs, Accordion, Dropdown, Tooltip
issues.user_story: As a user, I want dense data displays and contextual UI elements so that I can inspect structured memory records comfortably.
issues.description: Develop high-performance Table component with column sorting, animated Tabs switching, collapsible Accordions, context Dropdowns, and hover Tooltips.
acceptance_criteria: Table renders sortable headers, striped rows, and selection checkboxes
Tabs provide smooth animated indicator transitions
Accordion handles single or multiple section expansion
Tooltip positions accurately relative to viewport boundaries

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.5] Search Bar, Filter Panel, Pagination, Breadcrumb
issues.user_story: As a user, I want filtering, search, and navigation controls so that I can quickly pinpoint specific memories within large datasets.
issues.description: Build debounced SearchBar with clear button, expandable FilterPanel with category chips, numeric Pagination bar, and hierarchical Breadcrumbs.
acceptance_criteria: SearchBar provides debounced onChange callbacks with shortcut triggers (/)
FilterPanel allows multi-criteria filtering with active badge counts
Pagination supports page jumping, next/prev, and items-per-page selection
Breadcrumb reflects current route hierarchy with clickable segments

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.6] Toast, Avatar, Empty State, Error State
issues.user_story: As a user, I want clear feedback on actions and helpful empty/error states so that I am never left confused by application status.
issues.description: Create Toast notification system with auto-dismiss timers, user Avatars with status dots, descriptive EmptyState graphics, and recoverable ErrorState views.
acceptance_criteria: Toast supports success, error, warning, and info variants with action buttons
Avatar handles image fallback, initials, and active online indicator
EmptyState displays customizable iconography, title, and call-to-action button
ErrorState provides retry mechanism and technical error details toggle

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.7] Chart Wrapper, Timeline Component
issues.user_story: As a user, I want responsive chart containers and timeline visualizations so that analytical trends and memory event logs look sharp.
issues.description: Construct Recharts responsive wrapper with uniform dark styling, custom tooltips, legend formatting, and vertical/horizontal Timeline primitives.
acceptance_criteria: ChartWrapper provides responsive container with loading skeletons and empty fallbacks
Custom chart tooltip matches dark theme typography and metric formatting
Timeline renders connecting nodes, custom status icons, and timestamp labels
Chart components support seamless resize handling without layout shifts

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [2.8] Mock data layer (JSON files + service functions)
issues.user_story: As a developer, I want an end-to-end mock data layer so that the frontend can simulate full pipeline analysis, memory storage, and analytics offline.
issues.description: Create structured JSON datasets (memories, analytics, dashboard, baselines) and asynchronous service mocks simulating network latency and mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Comprehensive mock datasets covering all 4 decision outcomes (STORE, ENCRYPT, FORGET, COMPRESS)
Mock service functions simulating getMemories, analyzeMemory, deleteMemory, and getAnalytics
Simulated network latency and error injection parameters for resilient testing
Local storage persistence for user-added test memories across browser reloads

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [3.1] Stats cards (total memories, encrypted, forgotten, avg AMGS)
issues.user_story: As an administrator, I want key metric summary cards on the dashboard so that I can immediately monitor overall memory retention health.
issues.description: Implement 4 primary stats cards displaying Total Memories, Encrypted Records, Forgotten Memories, and Average AMGS Score with percentage changes.
acceptance_criteria: Displays accurate aggregated counts and AMGS average from mock service
Includes percentage delta indicators comparing current period to previous week
Animated number roll-up effect on initial dashboard load
Clicking a card navigates with filtered context to Memory Vault

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [3.2] Decision distribution chart (pie/donut — Recharts)
issues.user_story: As an administrator, I want an interactive donut chart showing firewall decisions so that I can observe the proportion of stored vs forgotten data.
issues.description: Construct Recharts Donut chart breaking down memories into STORE, ENCRYPT, FORGET, and COMPRESS with center summary metric and custom legends.
acceptance_criteria: Donut chart renders slices with distinct color tokens (emerald, amber, rose, cyan)
Hovering slice highlights corresponding percentage and count in centered label
Interactive legend allows toggling visibility of specific decision categories
Responsive scaling on mobile viewports without text clipping

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [3.3] Activity feed (recent memory events)
issues.user_story: As a user, I want a live activity stream on the dashboard so that I can trace recently processed memories and automated firewall actions in real time.
issues.description: Develop real-time activity stream displaying timestamp, memory title snippet, decision badge, AMGS score, and triggering event icon.
acceptance_criteria: Shows recent 10 memory lifecycle actions with relative timestamps (e.g. '2m ago')
Displays color-coded decision badges and stage icon indicators
Quick-view drawer opens when clicking any event item for full inspection
Smooth transition animation when new mock events are appended

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [3.4] Privacy score widget
issues.user_story: As a security auditor, I want a consolidated privacy score widget so that I can verify data sanitization and confidentiality levels at a glance.
issues.description: Create privacy health meter featuring circular gauge, risk grade (A+, A, B, C), sensitive entity redaction count, and encryption percentage.
acceptance_criteria: Circular progress gauge rendering overall system privacy score (0–100%)
Breakdown of PII redacted, AES-256 encrypted entries, and zero-leakage guarantee badge
Dynamic status text explaining risk tier and suggested optimization
Direct link button to Privacy Dashboard

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [3.5] Quick actions panel
issues.user_story: As a user, I want quick action shortcut buttons on the dashboard so that I can trigger memory tests, purge cache, or export reports with one click.
issues.description: Build quick action grid providing triggers for 'New Memory Analysis', 'Trigger Decay Cycle', 'Export Audit Log', and 'Purge Expired Data'.
acceptance_criteria: Quick actions grid with icons, titles, and keyboard shortcut indicators
'Analyze Memory' button immediately routes to Memory Lab
'Trigger Decay' triggers mock decay calculation with success toast
'Export Audit' generates downloadable JSON/CSV summary file

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [3.6] Storage summary widget
issues.user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a storage summary widget so that I can assess database capacity, compression savings, and FAISS vector index status.
issues.description: Develop storage usage meter displaying allocated memory vs capacity, compression ratio savings (e.g. 64% reduction), and vector embedding count.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-segment progress bar showing raw memory, compressed memory, and free space
Displays compression savings metric and storage efficiency multiplier
Shows vector index count and FAISS index health badge
Tooltip breaks down storage size by memory category

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [4.1] Text input + character counter
issues.user_story: As a researcher, I want an intuitive text area with sample prompts and character counter so that I can easily test firewall evaluation scenarios.
issues.description: Construct Memory Lab input area with real-time character/token counter, clear trigger, preset test prompt selector (PII, Chat, Sensitive, Redundant).
acceptance_criteria: Textarea auto-grows dynamically with input length and supports placeholder styling
Live character and estimated token counter with warning on exceeding limit
Preset selector dropdown pre-fills realistic test prompts with one click
Clear button resets input and previous analysis state

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [4.2] Analyze button with loading state
issues.user_story: As a user, I want an interactive analyze button with loading animation so that I understand evaluation is taking place through the pipeline.
issues.description: Implement prominent primary action button triggering memory analysis with animated spinner, progress text, execution timer, and disabled states.
acceptance_criteria: Disabled when input text is empty or analysis is actively running
Transitions to loading state with glowing pulse effect during computation
Displays elapsed execution milliseconds upon completion
Supports Cmd+Enter / Ctrl+Enter keyboard shortcut execution

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [4.3] Mock analysis pipeline visualization
issues.user_story: As an AI engineer, I want a step-by-step pipeline visualization so that I can follow how the 11 AMGS analysis stages process the input sequentially.
issues.description: Construct animated 11-stage pipeline flow component (Language, NER, Privacy, Embedding, Novelty, Relevance, Decay, Usefulness, AMGS Calculation).
acceptance_criteria: Renders 11 distinct stage pills with status icons (pending, active, completed, flagged)
Sequential step animation simulating real-time processing through each stage
Clicking any stage opens detail inspection panel with intermediate output
Visual warning highlights stages where PII or low-novelty thresholds were tripped

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [4.4] Decision result card with confidence indicator
issues.user_story: As a user, I want a comprehensive decision result card so that I understand what action the firewall took and the rationale behind it.
issues.description: Create primary result showcase displaying final verdict (STORE, ENCRYPT, FORGET, COMPRESS), confidence percentage meter, and human-readable explanation.
acceptance_criteria: Prominent decision badge with high-contrast theme coloring
Confidence gauge indicating model certainty (0–100%)
Detailed rationale paragraph explaining AMGS scoring breakdown
Action buttons to 'Save to Vault' or 'Re-evaluate with Custom Weights'

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [4.5] Factor score bars (7 AMGS factors)
issues.user_story: As a researcher, I want horizontal bar charts for all 7 AMGS factors so that I can inspect the exact sub-scores driving the decision.
issues.description: Build interactive horizontal progress bars representing the 7 AMGS factors (Sensitivity, Privacy Risk, Novelty, Semantic Relevance, Temporal Utility, Access Frequency, Verification Status).
acceptance_criteria: 7 individual factor progress bars with score numbers (0.00 to 1.00)
Color gradients shifting from green (optimal) to red (high risk/low utility)
Hover tooltip explaining mathematical formula and assigned weight multiplier
Animated bar fill transitions upon analysis completion

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [4.6] AMGS score gauge
issues.user_story: As a user, I want a radial AMGS score gauge so that I can visualize where the composite score sits relative to firewall retention thresholds.
issues.description: Construct semi-circular radial gauge rendering final AMGS composite score (0.00–1.00) with color zones for Forget (<0.35), Encrypt (0.35–0.70), and Store (>0.70).
acceptance_criteria: Radial needle/arc gauge animating smoothly to final score value
Configurable threshold markers showing decision cutoff points
Classification badge (e.g. 'High Utility — Store in FAISS Vault')
Responsive sizing adapting to tablet and mobile lab views

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [5.1] Search + filter bar
issues.user_story: As a user, I want search and filtering tools in Memory Vault so that I can locate specific memory records across thousands of items.

acceptance_criteria: Real-time search filtering across memory title, content, and entity tags
Quick filter chips for decision status with item count badges

Grid view renders multi-column card layout with visual score meters

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [5.3] Memory cards with status badges

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [5.4] Sort options

acceptance_criteria: Supports sorting by: Highest AMGS, Lowest AMGS, Newest, Oldest, Most Accessed
Ascending/Descending toggle button with arrow orientation change

Immediate in-memory sort re-ordering without full page re-render

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [5.5] Pagination
issues.user_story: As a user, I want smooth pagination controls so that I can navigate large collections of memories without performance degradation.
issues.description: Implement responsive pagination toolbar showing item ranges (e.g. 'Showing 1–12 of 84 memories'), page numbers, and items-per-page selector.
acceptance_criteria: Displays current page, total pages, and direct page jump buttons
Selector for 12, 24, 48 items per page with instant re-pagination
Disables previous/next buttons at collection boundaries
Scrolls smoothly to top of vault view when switching pages

acceptance_criteria: Renders full unmasked text (or decrypted view with confirmation)
Displays extracted NER tags (People, Locations, Keys, Dates) with pill badges

acceptance_criteria: Displays illustration, explanatory text, and active filter query summary

'Load Sample Memories' button populates mock database if vault is clean

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [6.1] Decision distribution (bar + pie)

acceptance_criteria: Bar chart compares decision counts across memory categories
Pie chart displays overall proportion with interactive slice highlights
Displays key ratio metrics (e.g. 'Retention Rate: 42.5%')
Interactive tooltips with formatted numbers and percentage shares

100% sanitization success indicator badge with zero-leakage verification

acceptance_criteria: Visual horizontal bars with category icons and memory counts

Net memory storage growth curve overlaid on secondary axis
Interactive crosshair tooltip showing exact monthly figures
Toggle buttons for monthly, quarterly, and annual aggregation

issues.title: AIMF Frontend — [6.6] Performance metrics
